# Vox
[color=#ffa500]Warning! This species is not recommended for new players due to their fatal allergy to oxygen![/color]
## General information
Their sharp talons make their unarmed attacks deal Slash damage, rather than Blunt.
Their highly-efficient digestive systems can not only process regular foods, but also raw meat, eggshells, banana peels, snack packaging, and even welding fuel.
Their anaerobic blood isn't iron-based, and therefore isn't replenished when metabolizing iron.
They [color=#1e90ff]slowly recover from Poison damage[/color] on their own.
## Oxygen allergy
Vox breathe nitrogen, and [color=#ffa500]oxygen is poisonous to them[/color]. Unfortunately, Nanotrasen space stations are designed for oxygen-breathing species, so Vox must breathe from a nitrogen tank at almost all times to avoid fatal exposure.
Vox always spawn wearing working nitrogen internals. Similarly to most other species, a spare breathing mask and emergency nitrogen tank is also provided in their survival box.
Vox's innate ability to heal Poison damage also applies to oxygen poisoning, giving them some leeway to briefly take off their internals to eat, drink, take oral medication, and so on.
